memoryLine.0: Pick one weak spot today and explain it to yourself for five minutes.
memoryLine.1: Tie the concept you just learned to one problem so it sticks.
memoryLine.2: When you get stuck, write the known facts before pushing forward.
memoryLine.3: When reviewing mistakes, focus on why the wrong choice looked right.
memoryLine.4: Keep examples next to conclusions when organizing notes.
memoryLine.5: After practice, add one reusable method for next time.
memoryLine.6: If the topics feel scattered, group them by chapter or theme first.
memoryLine.7: Glance at today's key takeaways before bed so tomorrow starts faster.
